```plato
    // The face left where a vertex was: the midpoints of the edges meeting at
    // it. Taken in reversed rotation order so it winds counter-clockwise seen
    // from outside, like the faces it neighbours.
    AmboFaceOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.ReversedVertexCornerRing(vertex).Map(c => VertexIndex(self.CornerUndirectedEdge(c).Value));
```
